key.name: entries
key.description: Configured Quake-mode applications. Each entry is an id, desktop app id, dock side, keyboard shortcut, and default size percentage.

key.name: focus-before-hide
key.summary: Focus an unfocused window before hiding it
key.description: When the shortcut is pressed while the window is shown but does not have focus, raise and focus it instead of hiding it. Pressing again hides it.
